# pheno-ssot-template

## Purpose
Canonical single-source-of-truth (SSOT) starter template for any new project in the pheno-* fleet.

## Invariants
1. Every error is `pheno_errors::AppError`.
2. Every log line is structured tracing.
3. Every config is loaded via `pheno_config::load::<MyConfig>()`.
4. Every schema lives in `pheno-zod-schemas` or `pheno-pydantic-models`.

## Dependencies
- pheno-errors
- pheno-tracing
- pheno-config
- pheno-tokio-base
- serde
- tokio
- tracing

## File Structure
- Cargo.toml.template — rendered Cargo manifest
- src/lib.rs.template — rendered library source
- template.yaml — SSOT manifest format
- scripts/ — SSOT invariant checks
- deny.toml — cargo-deny baseline

## MSRV
1.75
